A second PawnKindDef (OuterRim_ImperialDTSeriesSentryDroid) exists in the same file but is COMMENTED OUT in the XML -- not live content, excluded here.

backstories.title: Droid
backstories.baseDesc: Droids, less commonly known as robots or automatons, are mechanical beings that possess artificial intellgience. They are used in a variety of roles and environments, often those considered too medial or dangerous for organic species, but also in fields that require extensive specialization and knowledge.

backstories.title: Old Droid
backstories.baseDesc: Droids are often around for longer than their creators, some have been operational for hundreds, if not thousands of years.

_extract_droiddepot.json.note: Read-only extraction. Task brief said '10 concrete + 1 abstract base' humanlike and '8 concrete + 2 abstract bases' animal, but the actual file list supplied (and read in full) contains 11 concrete humanlike races and 8 concrete animal races (Droid__BaseAstromech.xml is NOT Abstract despite its filename - it is a concrete ThingDef, OuterRim_AstromechDroid, that simply has no PawnKindDef of its own in that file). Total concrete races = 19. Total PawnKindDefs = 19 (the 19th kind, OuterRim_RSeriesDroid, reuses the OuterRim_AstromechDroid race rather than declaring a new race).

_extract_jds.json.note: Common/ has no Defs folder in this mod (only Languages/Sounds/Textures), so despite LoadFolders.xml listing 'Common' for v1.6, all droid ThingDefs/PawnKindDefs live under 1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Race.xml. Also checked and confirmed empty of droid-relevant content: 1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings.xml (mech gestator building is fully commented out), 1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Factions.xml (no ThingDef/PawnKindDef tags present), 1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Bodies.xml (BodyDefs only, referenced by <race><body> but not part of the extraction schema), 1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Sounds.xml, 1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_WorkGivers.xml, 1.6/Defs/Scenarios.xml, and 1.6/Patches/ThingDefs_Patch.xml (defines JDSCIS_*_Recipe RecipeDefs for a mech gestator/resurrection-droid workflow that consume these ThingDefs as products; does not patch stats on the droid ThingDefs/PawnKindDefs themselves).
_extract_jds.json.graphicsMechanismNote: None of these ThingDefs declare a <graphicData> block. All sprite data lives on the PAIRED PawnKindDef, under lifeStages/li/bodyGraphicData (two identical <li> life-stage entries per kind in every case read). The 'graphics' object below is therefore sourced from the paired PawnKindDef's bodyGraphicData, not from ThingDef.graphicData. shaderType is never declared (one commented-out CutoutWithOverlay example exists on JDSCIS_B1_Commander_Droid's kind only, inert) so it is omitted throughout.
_extract_jds.json.bodySizeNote: baseBodySize is declared once, at 0.7, on the abstract parent ThingDef Name="JDSSWCIS_Droids" (ParentName="BasePawn"). No concrete droid ThingDef overrides it, so 0.7 is the effective inherited value for every race below.
uncertainOrUnresolved: isFighter: this field does not appear on any PawnKindDef in this mod (grepped for 'isFighter' across ThingDefs_Race.xml, no match) -- reported as null throughout, not fabricated.
EMPSensitivity / canBeAmbushed: not declared anywhere in this mod's droid defs -- omitted, not fabricated.

JDSCIS_LR-57_Combat_Droid PawnKindDef's <label> is literally 'LR-57_Combat_Droid' (with underscores, unlike every sibling kind's spaced label) -- copied verbatim, likely an authoring typo in the source mod, not corrected here.

_extract_galacticempire.json.notes: Outer Rim - Galactic Empire (workshop 2919248699, packageId Neronix17.OuterRim.GalacticEmpire) ships NO droid-specific AssetBundle art of its own -- checked all 697 Texture2D entries in Common/AssetBundles/neronix17_outerrim_galacticempire, zero matched 'droid' or 'kx' in container path or name. The only droid content this pack contributes is the OuterRim_ImperialKXSecurityDroid PawnKindDef above, which reuses Droid Depot's KX race and its already-extracted art (src/Jawa/Droidworks/Textures/OuterRim/Droid/KX/). LoadFolders.xml v1.6 loads: /, Common, 1.6, and conditionally 1.6/Mods/OuterRimDroidDepot when Neronix17.OuterRim.DroidDepot is active -- that conditional folder is where PawnKinds_Droids.xml (source of this kind) lives.
